messages:
jamal: Heads-up — private/VPC installer v1.14.0 delivery window tomorrow 03:00-05:00 UTC. Packaging finished, need final ops + security signoff before we hand to transport.

katie: thanks. can we attach the release notes draft here? also any breaking changes callouts?

jamal: release notes: core change is image diffing for smaller delta bundles, KMS key rotation support in installer. No breaking API changes for customers. Draft excerpt: "Installer now supports staged KMS key rotation (opt-in). See upgrade notes."

lorenzo: packaging checksums posted to artifact storage. i did a quick verify: sha256sums match locally. we should cosign the manifest before transport.

ana: @lorenzo where's the cosign key? is it the transport KMS or on-prem signer?

lorenzo: using staging KMS for the cosign operation this run. key id: projects/redwood-kms/keys/installer-signing-v2. ops playbook updated.

maria: deploy-bot, run preflight checks and canary plan for v1.14.0 please. we want a pinned canary to 3 enterprise clusters for 30m then wider push.

deploy-bot: preflight checks queued: image integrity, cosign verification, manifest schema, offline bundle-size. ETA 2m.

deploy-bot: preflight result: PASSED (image integrity: ok, cosign: ok, manifest: ok, sizes: ok).

ana: thumbs up. question on rollback — plan is to pin clients to v1.13.4 if we see agent memory regression, correct?

maria: correct. rollback plan: immediate pin to 1.13.4 artifact + instruct deploy-bot to abort cutover and reroute customers to reserved route. Manual approval required to re-run packaging.

ana: noted. do we have a hotfix branch ready if we need to patch the delta algorithm?

jamal: yes, branch hotfix/delta-1.14.0 ready. ci artifacts built and test coverage run. If rollback triggered, we will cut hotfix, update manifest, and re-cosign.

lorenzo: small ops reminder: transport window is tight — transporter team needs signed manifest by 02:30 UTC to make the courier run. cosign schedule set for 02:15 UTC.

katie: release notes link: https://docs.internal/release/v1.14.0-draft (please add upgrade caveat about KMS config).

maria: locking change window now. final checklist: (1) security review done? (2) cosign key rotated recently? (3) canary clusters notified.

ana: security review: done. cosign key rotation: last rotated 9 days ago — within window. canary clusters pinged.

deploy-bot: scheduled cosign job at 02:15 UTC. canary rollout to begin 03:00 UTC, target 3 clusters for 30m, health checks every 5m.

srebot: canary health probe template: /healthz, 95th p99 latency threshold 1.2s, error rate threshold 0.5%. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall.

maria: ok locking it — i'll post release notes and hand to transport after cosign completes. if anyone objects speak now or file a block. :thumbsup:

katie: :thumbsup:

lorenzo: :thumbsup:

ana: :thumbsup:

jamal: thanks all. will watch the deploy-bot logs and be oncall during the window.

deploy-bot: cosign job complete: success. manifest signed: sha256:abc123... Transport ready.

maria: handed to transport. closing thread, will reopen if rollback needed.
